title: SOMETHING HAPPENED HERE
paragraph: These photographs record visible consequences of encounter: something prepared, consumed, touched, arranged or otherwise changed because a living presence acted upon it.

title: WHILE WE WERE HERE
definition: Lives briefly occupying the same moment.
paragraph: Gatherings, journeys and shared activities place independent lives within the same field of observation, whether or not those lives ever directly meet.

title: THINGS THAT EXISTED FOR ME
definition: Something the world presented and I happened to notice.
paragraph: Places, structures and ordinary details become part of the archive because, among everything present, they were the things that held the photographer's attention.

title: THE THINGS I DIDN'T GO LOOKING FOR
paragraph: Animals, objects, flowers and visual interruptions entered the photograph unexpectedly, turning an unplanned encounter into a lasting record.

title: NOTHING HAPPENED HERE
definition: And yet — this was real presence.
paragraph: No person, shadow or human figure occupies these frames; the quiet environment remains, witnessed by the presence required to make the photograph.

title: BETWEEN PLACES
paragraph: Routes, stairs, passageways, stations and views from transit give attention to spaces usually experienced only while moving toward somewhere else.
